args.title: Remember the user's last chosen export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's selected export format (e.g., via localStorage) and read it back as the initial value instead of always defaulting to defaultFormat = "csv", so the format <select> remembers the last used format across visits.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This component hardcodes defaultFormat = "csv" and keeps the chosen format only in local component state, never persisting it anywhere, so the export format selector resets on every reload instead of remembering the user's last choice.
